title: A cloud erase whose session changed during the engine call, or that came back with no view, never reaches showErased: the store does not count it, and the erase's later steps read whatever record is then shown
evidence: From the adversary review of PR 1599 (F6). ios/HealthRoadmap/Sync/CloudSync.swift erase returns before showErased when connection.shownSession moved or result.view is nil, so erasures does not move. DataEraser then runs its Apple Health, units and reminders steps on the record shown. Outside PR 1599's rule (it covers an erase the store has taken in). Needs a decision on what the store holds in that case. US-25 AC16
